units.source_text: 大概是已经清扫完澡盆，传来了将水桶放在水泥地上的声音。

en.t: The bathtub had probably already been cleaned, and the sound came of a bucket being set down on the cement floor.

units.source_text: 阿泷在水榭柱旁发现了花炮。

en.t: Otaki found some fireworks beside a pillar of the waterside pavilion.

units.source_text: 阿雪从百日红的枝头上，取下客人的游泳衣穿上。

en.t: Ayuki took a guest's swimsuit down from the branch of the crape myrtle and put it on.
